remarks: Welcome to 1009 Price Canyon Road, where modern coastal living meets beautiful hillside views just minutes from downtown Pismo Beach and the shoreline. Built in 2018, this beautifully appointed 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers 1,924 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, contemporary finishes, and a fresh, move-in-ready interior. The main living level features an inviting open-concept floor plan that seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining, and living areas. High ceilings and expansive windows fill the space with natural light while framing the surrounding coastal hills.
